    Save slots (this device)

    Your plan auto-saves as you edit. 💾 Save (top bar) also writes it into a named save slot stored in IndexedDB (localStorage fallback). Slots survive reloads; persistent storage is requested so the browser should not evict them.

    ⚠️ iPhone/iPad: an app added to the Home Screen keeps its storage separate from Safari (and from the single-file copy in Files). Slots saved in one are not visible in the other. To move a plan, use Save to Files + Open file, or the save code below.

    Save to Files / open a file

    On iOS “Save to Files” opens the share sheet – choose Save to Files (iCloud Drive works across devices). Elsewhere it downloads race_plan_YYYY-MM-DD.json.

    Save code

    The save code contains your WHOLE plan (all seasons, trips, profile, settings) compressed — copy it somewhere safe and paste it later to restore.
